_note: REAL VERIFIED DATA — sourced directly from https://nsfdc.nic.in (official NSFDC website, Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Govt of India) on 2026-09-04. Every field traces to a specific official page. Fields not published by NSFDC are explicitly marked data_status: 'unavailable' — none were invented.

schemes.short_description: Micro credit finance for very small income-generating units.
schemes.purpose: Micro Credit Finance for units costing up to ₹1.40 lakh.
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Individuals belonging to the Scheduled Caste community with annual family income up to ₹5.00 lakh; also Partnership Firms and Co-operative Societies where all members are SC and each member's income is within the ceiling.

schemes.short_description: Standard term loan for larger income-generating business units.
schemes.purpose: Term loans for units costing more than ₹1.40 lakh and up to ₹50.00 lakh.
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Individuals belonging to the Scheduled Caste community with annual family income up to ₹5.00 lakh; also Partnership Firms and Co-operative Societies meeting the same membership/income conditions.

schemes.short_description: Micro finance routed through NBFC-MFIs for small/micro business activities.
schemes.purpose: Prompt, need-based micro finance to eligible Scheduled Caste persons at reasonable interest rates through selected NBFC-MFIs, to pursue small/micro business activities.
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Individuals belonging to the Scheduled Caste community with annual family income up to ₹5.00 lakh.

schemes.short_description: Loans routed through Cooperative Societies/Banks and Small Finance Banks for small/micro activities.
schemes.purpose: Loans for projects/units costing up to ₹5.00 lakh, provided through Cooperative Societies, Cooperative Banks, and Small Finance Banks (SFBs), to pursue small/micro activities.
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Individuals belonging to the Scheduled Caste community with annual family income up to ₹5.00 lakh.
schemes.assistance_type: Term loan (via Cooperative Banks/Societies or Small Finance Banks)

schemes.short_description: Education loans for recognized professional/technical courses, in India or abroad.
schemes.purpose: Educational loans for eligible students pursuing regular full-time professional/technical recognized courses approved by the Government, in India or abroad.
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Students belonging to the Scheduled Caste community who have secured admission to a recognized professional/technical course.

funding_information.loan_cap_rule: Up to ₹40.00 lakh OR 90% of course fee, whichever is less
funding_information.repayment_period: Up to 12 years if repayment not yet started; up to 10 years if loan disbursed and repayment already started
funding_information.moratorium_period: Course period plus 1 year (if repayment not started); up to 6 months (if loan disbursed and repayment started)

shared_eligibility_rules._note: These rules apply across all 5 NSFDC credit-linked schemes above (except where a scheme has its own specific rule, e.g. ELS requires course admission, not income-generating activity). Source: https://nsfdc.nic.in/eligibility-requirements

rules.source_reference: https://nsfdc.nic.in/eligibility-requirements — 'The beneficiary(ies) must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) community.'

https://nsfdc.nic.in/eligibility-requirements — 'The annual family income of applicants must not exceed ₹5.00 lakh (applicable to both rural and urban areas, effective from January 7, 2026).' Note: this ₹5 lakh ceiling does NOT apply to Skill Development Training Programmes (no income criterion for those).
https://nsfdc.nic.in/eligibility-requirements — 'Individuals, Partnership Firms, and Co-operative Societies are eligible to undertake income-generating activities.'

https://nsfdc.nic.in/eligibility-requirements — applies only if applicant_entity_type is partnership_firm or cooperative_society: 'All members of the Partnership Firm or Co-operative Society must belong to the Scheduled Caste community', and each member's income must individually be within the ₹5 lakh ceiling.

application_process.primary_channel: Online via PM-SURAJ Portal (pmsuraj.dosje.gov.in) — OTP-based registration, digital form, document upload, application tracking by Application ID.
application_process.secondary_channel: Offline, via the applicant's State Channelizing Agency (SCA) or Channelizing Agency (CA), submitted at the nearest district or head office branch.
application_process.important_note: NSFDC does NOT accept direct applications or correspondence from applicants — all applications must be routed through an SCA/CA. Eligibility verification is the primary responsibility of the SCA/CA, though NSFDC reserves the right to re-verify at its own discretion.

required_documents_general._note: NSFDC's public site does NOT publish a granular, per-scheme document checklist — it states the checklist is maintained by each individual SCA/CA. Only these general categories are officially confirmed. data_status is deliberately 'unavailable' for anything more specific — do not expand this list without a named source.

documents.name: Other documents as per the specific SCA/CA's checklist
